==== model: The Weatherman ====

$likelihood
Dv ~ dlnorm(mu, sigma[cell])

$main_model
mu <- loga[Mg] + gamma * (Mo - 1) + b[Lo] * sigma_loc + yr[Yr] * 
    sigma_yr + tr[Tr] * sigma_tr + cv[Cv] + b_deg * deg_h_z + 
    b_precip * precip_72h_z + b_seq * seq_depth_z

$gamma_def
gamma <- s_conv + gap_shift * (Mg - 1)

$prior_loga
loga[Mg] ~ dnorm(2, 2)

$prior_b
b[Lo] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_s
s_conv ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_gs
gap_shift ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_yr
yr[Yr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_tr
tr[Tr] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$pr_sigma
sigma[cell] ~ dexp(3.46)

$pr_sigma_loc
sigma_loc ~ dexp(2.31)

$pr_sigma_tr
sigma_tr ~ dexp(2.31)

$pr_sigma_yr
sigma_yr ~ dexp(2.31)

$prior_cv
cv[Cv] ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_deg
b_deg ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_precip
b_precip ~ dnorm(0, 1)

$prior_seq
b_seq ~ dnorm(0, 1)
